instruction: Please create a system service account named "servicebot" with /usr/sbin/nologin as the shell to prevent interactive login.

result.command: USERNAME="servicebot"; id "$USERNAME" &>/dev/null && SHELL=$(getent passwd "$USERNAME" | cut -d: -f7) && [ "$SHELL" = "/usr/sbin/nologin" ] && echo 'Service account created with nologin shell' || echo 'Check failed'

include: Service account created with nologin shell
